faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to the most common questions about Zikirmatik Asistan AI.

items.question: What is Zikirmatik Asistan AI?
items.answer: Zikirmatik Asistan AI is a mindful dhikr counter and habit-building companion that helps you track, organize and stay consistent with your daily dhikr practice.

items.question: Is Zikirmatik Asistan AI free to use?
items.answer: Yes. The core dhikr counter, collections, reminders, streaks and Google Sign-In sync are free to use. Optional Premium credit packages unlock the AI Rehber feature and additional personalization.

items.question: What is AI Rehber?
items.answer: AI Rehber is an optional AI-assisted guidance feature. You start with 1 free credit, and additional credit packages (3, 10, 30, 50 or 75) can be purchased from within the app on Google Play.

items.question: Do I need an account to use the app?
items.answer: No account is required to use the core features. Signing in with Google is optional and lets you securely back up and sync your collections, streaks and settings across devices.

items.question: What data does Zikirmatik Asistan AI collect?
items.answer: We collect only the data necessary to provide the app's features, such as your dhikr collections, streaks and account information if you choose to sign in. See our Privacy Policy for full details.

items.question: Can I delete my account and data?
items.answer: Yes. You can request deletion of your account and associated data at any time by contacting us at serhatbelen7.developer@gmail.com.

items.question: How do reminders and special-day notifications work?
items.answer: You can set daily reminder times for your dhikr goals, and the app can also notify you about special days and Kandil nights so you never miss a meaningful occasion.

items.question: What is your refund policy for credit packages?
items.answer: Credit package purchases are handled through Google Play and are subject to Google Play's billing policies. Please see our Refund Policy page for full details on how to request a refund.

items.question: How can I contact support?
items.answer: You can reach our team any time at serhatbelen7.developer@gmail.com — we're happy to help with questions, feedback or issues.

contact.title: We'd love to hear from you
contact.subtitle: Questions, feedback or support requests — send us an email and we'll get back to you.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how Zikirmatik Asistan AI ("we", "us", "our app") collects, uses, discloses and protects your information when you use our mobile application.

sections.heading: 1. Information We Collect
sections.body: We collect information you provide directly, such as your dhikr collections, custom targets, preferences and, if you choose to sign in with Google, basic account information (name, email address and profile identifier) provided by Google Sign-In. We also collect usage information such as streaks, counts and app settings needed to provide the app's features, and technical information such as device type, operating system version and crash diagnostics to keep the app reliable.

sections.heading: 2. How We Use Your Information
sections.body: We use the information we collect to operate and improve the app, to securely back up and sync your collections, streaks and settings across your devices when you sign in with Google, to send you the reminders and notifications you configure (including daily targets and special-day/Kandil notifications), to process optional Premium credit purchases through Google Play, and to provide customer support when you contact us.

sections.heading: 3. Google Sign-In
sections.body: If you choose to sign in with Google, we receive limited profile information from Google (such as your name, email address and profile identifier) solely to create and secure your account and to sync your data across devices. We do not access your Google password, and you may revoke this access at any time from your Google account settings.

sections.heading: 4. Data Storage and Security
sections.body: Your data is stored using industry-standard security practices, including encrypted connections in transit. We retain your account data for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide the app's features, and we take reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect it against unauthorized access, alteration or loss.

sections.heading: 5. Data Sharing
sections.body: We do not sell your personal information. We may share limited information with trusted service providers who help us operate the app (such as cloud hosting, authentication and payment processing through Google Play), and only to the extent necessary for them to perform those services, or where required by law.

sections.heading: 6. Notifications
sections.body: The app may send local and push notifications for daily dhikr reminders and special-day/Kandil occasions that you configure. You can manage or disable notifications at any time from your device settings.

sections.heading: 7. Your Rights and Choices
sections.body: You may access, update or delete the dhikr collections and settings stored in the app at any time. You may request deletion of your account and associated data, or ask us questions about how your information is handled, by contacting us at serhatbelen7.developer@gmail.com. We will respond to and process such requests within a reasonable time.

sections.heading: 8. Children's Privacy
sections.body: Zikirmatik Asistan AI is not directed at children under the age of 13, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you believe a child has provided us with personal information, please contact us so we can remove it.

sections.heading: 9. Changes to This Policy
sections.body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes to the app or applicable law. We will update the "Last updated" date above when we do, and encourage you to review this page periodically.

sections.heading: 10. Contact Us
sections.body: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or how your data is handled, please contact us at serhatbelen7.developer@gmail.com.

refund.title: Refund Policy
refund.intro: This Refund Policy explains how refund requests for optional Premium credit purchases made within Zikirmatik Asistan AI are handled.

sections.body: All Premium credit package purchases (3, 10, 30, 50 or 75 credits) are processed and billed through Google Play. As a result, refunds are subject to Google Play's own refund policies and timeframes, in addition to the guidance below.

sections.heading: 2. How to Request a Refund

sections.heading: 3. Eligibility
sections.body: Refund eligibility generally depends on how recently the purchase was made and whether the purchased credits have already been used. We reserve the right to evaluate refund requests on a case-by-case basis, consistent with Google Play's policies and applicable consumer protection laws.

sections.heading: 4. Unused Credits
sections.body: Purchased AI Rehber credits that have not yet been used are generally more likely to be eligible for a refund than credits that have already been consumed. Please contact us as soon as possible if you believe a purchase was made in error.

sections.heading: 5. Processing Time
sections.body: Refunds processed directly through Google Play typically follow Google's standard processing timeframes. Refund requests sent to us directly will be acknowledged promptly and, where applicable, forwarded for processing as soon as possible.

sections.heading: 6. Contact Us
sections.body: For any questions about this Refund Policy or to start a refund request, please contact us at serhatbelen7.developer@gmail.com.
